';
let sdShareCanvas=null,sdSharePhase='',sdSharePreviousFocus=null;
function sdShareData(phase){
 const s1=E.stage1Stats(state),s2=E.stage2Stats(state),v=E.verdict(state),a=club('A'),b=club('B');
 if(phase==='1'&&!s1.complete)throw Error('Finish Stage 1 before sharing results');
 if(phase==='2'&&!s2.complete)throw Error('Finish Stage 2 before sharing results');
 if(phase==='full'&&!['champion','stage1-champion'].includes(v.status))throw Error('Finish the Showdown before sharing the full results');
 const main=phase==='1'?{a:s1.team.A.w,b:s1.team.B.w,title:'STAGE 1',subtitle:'TEAM ROUND ROBIN',foot:`TOTAL POINTS · ${s1.team.A.p} – ${s1.team.B.p}`,winner:s1.winner}:phase==='2'?{a:s2.wA,b:s2.wB,title:'STAGE 2',subtitle:'CUSTOM TEAM DUEL',foot:`${s2.total} DUELS · ${state.setup.courts} COURTS`,winner:s2.winner}:{a:v.points.A,b:v.points.B,title:'FINAL VERDICT',subtitle:'TEAM SHOWDOWN CHAMPION',foot:'CHAMPIONSHIP POINTS',winner:v.champion};
 const history=[];
 if(phase!=='1'&&s1.complete)history.push({label:'STAGE 1',detail:`${s1.team.A.w} – ${s1.team.B.w} WINS`,winner:s1.winner?club(s1.winner):'DRAW'});
 if(phase==='full'&&s2.complete)history.push({label:'STAGE 2',detail:`${s2.wA} – ${s2.wB} DUELS`,winner:club(s2.winner)});
 if(phase==='full'&&E.stage3Stats(state).winner)history.push({label:'THE DECIDER',detail:`${E.stage3Stats(state).wA} – ${E.stage3Stats(state).wB} duel wins`,winner:club(E.stage3Stats(state).winner)});
 return {phase,main,history,a,b,session:state.setup.sessionName||'PADEL 5IVE TEAM BATTLE',date:state.setup.date||'',winner:main.winner?club(main.winner):'DRAW',champion:phase==='full'};
}
function sdDrawCard(data,photo){
 const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=1080;canvas.height=1350;
 const c=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!c)throw Error('Canvas unavailable');
 const gold='#d6b68a',light='#f6f0e6',muted='#b2c0c8',dark='#0c1823',width=1080;
 const fill=(color,x,y,w,h)=>{c.fillStyle=color;c.fillRect(x,y,w,h)};
 const txt=(value,x,y,font,color=light,align='left')=>{c.textAlign=align;c.fillStyle=color;c.font=font;c.fillText(String(value),x,y)};
 const rule=(x,y,w,color='rgba(218,192,159,.30)')=>fill(color,x,y,w,2);
 const rounded=(x,y,w,h,r,color,stroke)=>{c.beginPath();c.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);c.fillStyle=color;c.fill();if(stroke){c.strokeStyle=stroke;c.lineWidth=2;c.stroke()}};
 const fit=(value,maxWidth,maxSize=54,minSize=23,weight=700)=>{let size=maxSize;c.font=`${weight} ${size}px Arial, sans-serif`;while(size>minSize&&c.measureText(String(value)).width>maxWidth){size-=1;c.font=`${weight} ${size}px Arial, sans-serif`;}return size;};
 const cover=(value,x,y,w,maxSize,color=light)=>{const sz=fit(value,w,maxSize,22,700);txt(value,x,y,`700 ${sz}px Arial, sans-serif`,color,'center')};
 // Background: deep slate with an actual PADEL 5IVE center-court photograph.
 fill('#0b1721',0,0,1080,1350);
 if(photo){const ratio=Math.max(width/photo.width,570/photo.height),ww=photo.width*ratio,hh=photo.height*ratio;c.drawImage(photo,(width-ww)/2,0,ww,hh);}
 const shade=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,990);shade.addColorStop(0,'rgba(8,16,24,.35)');shade.addColorStop(.32,'rgba(10,20,30,.78)');shade.addColorStop(.56,'rgba(10,20,29,.97)');shade.addColorStop(1,'#0b1721');fill(shade,0,0,1080,1100);
 const edge=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,1080,1350);edge.addColorStop(0,'#c5a177');edge.addColorStop(1,'#544c42');c.strokeStyle=edge;c.lineWidth=4;c.strokeRect(28,28,1024,1294);
 txt('PADEL 5IVE',70,108,'700 33px Arial, sans-serif',gold);
 txt('BEYOND 5IVE. BEYOND PLAY.',1011,107,'italic 19px Arial, sans-serif','#ded0ba','right');
 rule(70,136,940);
 txt('TEAM SHOWDOWN',540,260,'700 53px Arial, sans-serif',light,'center');
 txt(data.main.title+'  /  '+data.main.subtitle,540,316,'700 26px Arial, sans-serif',gold,'center');
 cover(data.session.toUpperCase(),540,382,900,fit(data.session.toUpperCase(),900,31,19));
 txt(data.date?data.date:'OFFICIAL SESSION RESULT',540,425,'21px Arial, sans-serif',muted,'center');
 // Main scores drawn with symmetric alignment and no auto-resizing shifts.
 rounded(66,490,948,382,22,'rgba(24,37,48,.91)','rgba(213,185,146,.39)');
 rule(105,550,870);
 cover(data.a,290,621,380,50);
 cover(data.b,790,621,380,50);
 txt(String(data.main.a),290,749,'700 121px Arial, sans-serif',gold,'center');
 txt('VS',540,722,'28px Arial, sans-serif',muted,'center');
 txt(String(data.main.b),790,749,'700 121px Arial, sans-serif',gold,'center');
 txt(data.main.foot,540,816,'700 21px Arial, sans-serif',gold,'center');
 const lineTop=904;
 txt(data.champion?'CHAMPION':'STAGE WINNER',540,945,'700 24px Arial, sans-serif',gold,'center');
 cover(data.winner.toUpperCase(),540,1018,875,60,gold);
 const yy=1056;
 if(data.history.length){
  rule(92,yy,896);
  data.history.forEach((item,i)=>{const y=1094+i*67;txt(item.label,96,y,'700 18px Arial, sans-serif',gold);txt(item.detail,530,y,'21px Arial, sans-serif',muted,'center');const who=item.winner.toUpperCase();const sz=fit(who,350,23,16,700);txt(who,973,y,`700 ${sz}px Arial, sans-serif`,light,'right');});
 }
 rule(70,1266,940);
 txt('PADEL 5IVE  /  OFFICIAL MATCH RESULT',70,1300,'700 18px Arial, sans-serif','#d7c0a0');
 txt('BEYOND 5IVE. BEYOND PLAY.',1006,1300,'italic 18px Arial, sans-serif',gold,'right');
 return canvas;
}
async function sdLoadPhoto(){return new Promise(resolve=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>resolve(im);im.onerror=()=>resolve(null);im.src=SD_SHARE_PHOTO;});}
async function openShowdownShareCard(phase){
 const data=sdShareData(phase);
 const photo=await sdLoadPhoto();
 const canvas=sdDrawCard(data,photo),uri=canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
 sdShareCanvas=canvas;sdSharePhase=phase;sdSharePreviousFocus=document.activeElement;
 document.getElementById('showdownShareLayer')?.remove();
 const layer=document.createElement('div');layer.id='showdownShareLayer';layer.className='showdown-share-layer';layer.setAttribute('role','presentation');
 layer.innerHTML=`<section class="showdown-share-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Official result card"><div class="sd-share-top"><strong>PADEL 5IVE · Result Card</strong><button type="button" class="sd-share-close" data-sd-share="close" aria-label="Close results card">✕</button></div><div class="sd-share-image-frame"><img alt="PADEL 5IVE ${esc(data.main.title)} visual results card" src="${uri}"></div><div class="sd-share-actions"><button type="button" data-sd-share="save">Save PNG</button><button type="button" class="primary" data-sd-share="share">Share Image</button><button type="button" data-sd-share="copy">Copy Summary</button><button type="button" data-sd-share="close">Close</button></div><div class="sd-share-feedback" role="status"></div><p class="sd-share-hint">Portrait · 1080 × 1350 · Share via iOS or save for Instagram / WhatsApp</p></section>`;
 document.body.appendChild(layer);document.body.classList.add('sd-share-open');
 layer.addEventListener('click',async ev=>{
  if(ev.target===layer){sdCloseShareCard();return;}
  const t=ev.target.closest('[data-sd-share]');if(!t)return;
  const action=t.dataset.sdShare;
  if(action==='close'){sdCloseShareCard();return;}
  const status=layer.querySelector('.sd-share-feedback');
  try{
   if(action==='save')await sdSavePNG(canvas,data);
   if(action==='share')await sdSharePNG(canvas,data);
   if(action==='copy')await sdCopySummary(phase);
   status.textContent=action==='save'?'PNG download started':action==='share'?'Image shared or download started':'Summary copied';
  }catch(e){status.textContent=e.message||'Action unavailable';}
 });
 layer.querySelector('.sd-share-close')?.focus();
}
function sdCloseShareCard(){document.getElementById('showdownShareLayer')?.remove();document.body.classList.remove('sd-share-open');sdSharePreviousFocus?.focus?.();sdShareCanvas=null;}
function sdPNGBlob(canvas){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>canvas.toBlob(blob=>blob?resolve(blob):reject(Error('Could not create PNG')),'image/png'));}
function sdFileName(data){return ('PADEL5IVE_TEAM_SHOWDOWN_'+data.main.title+'_'+(data.date||'RESULT')).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g,'_')+'.png';}
async function sdSavePNG(canvas,data){const blob=await sdPNGBlob(canvas);const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=sdFileName(data);document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),15000);}
async function sdSharePNG(canvas,data){
 const blob=await sdPNGBlob(canvas),file=new File([blob],sdFileName(data),{type:'image/png'});
 if(navigator.share&&navigator.canShare&&navigator.canShare({files:[file]})){
  try{await navigator.share({files:[file],title:'PADEL 5IVE · '+data.main.title});return;}catch(e){if(e.name==='AbortError')return;}
 }
 await sdSavePNG(canvas,data);
}
async function sdCopySummary(phase){
 const d=sdShareData(phase),s1=E.stage1Stats(state),s2=E.stage2Stats(state),v=E.verdict(state);
 const lines=['PADEL 5IVE · TEAM SHOWDOWN',d.session,`${d.a} vs ${d.b}`,d.main.title,`${d.main.a} – ${d.main.b}`,`${d.champion?'Champion':'Winner'}: ${d.winner}`];
 if(phase==='1')lines.push(`Total Points: ${s1.team.A.p} – ${s1.team.B.p}`);
 if(phase==='full')lines.push(`Stage 1: ${s1.winner?club(s1.winner):'Draw'}`,state.stage2?`Stage 2: ${club(s2.winner)}`:'',state.stage3?`Decider: ${club(E.stage3Stats(state).winner)}`:'',`Championship: ${v.points.A} – ${v.points.B}`);
 lines.push('BEYOND 5IVE. BEYOND PLAY.');
 const txt=lines.filter(Boolean).join('\n');
 if(navigator.clipboard?.writeText){await navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt);return;}
 const ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=txt;document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();try{if(!document.execCommand('copy'))throw Error('Copy is unsupported');}finally{ta.remove();}
}

function showChampionReveal(){
 // Inline and non-blocking: the final dashboard is the champion reveal.
 // Never create a modal, overlay or a required extra tap.
 document.getElementById('showdownRevealLayer')?.remove();
 if(!state.finalized||!E.verdict(state).champion)return;
 // Discard stale stage-transition notifications before revealing the winner.
 const previousToast=document.getElementById('toast');
 if(previousToast)previousToast.style.display='none';
 clearTimeout(toastTimeout);
 const card=document.getElementById('showdownChampionInline');
 if(!card)return;
 card.classList.remove('sd-celebrating');
 // Restart the gold shimmer only on a real championship transition or Replay.
 void card.offsetWidth;
 card.classList.add('sd-celebrating');
 const motionOK=!window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 try{card.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:motionOK?'smooth':'auto'});}catch(e){card.scrollIntoView();}
}

function act(btn){const action=btn.dataset.action,id=btn.dataset.id,value=btn.dataset.value;if(viewOnly&&!['pdf','filter-leaderboard'].includes(action))return;try{switch(action){
case 'complete-stage1':{
 const pair=app.querySelector('#p5-stage1-score-dialog'),a=pair?.querySelector('[data-side="A"]'),b=pair?.querySelector('[data-side="B"]');
 if(!a||!b||a.value===''||b.value==='')throw Error('Enter both scores first');
 const sc=E.validateScore(state.setup.format,Number(a.value),Number(b.value),false),m=E.matchPool(state).find(x=>x.id===id);
 if(!m||m.status!=='active')throw Error('Match is no longer active');
 pendingResult={id,a:sc.a,b:sc.b};
 document.querySelectorAll('.result-review-slot').forEach(x=>x.innerHTML='');
 const slot=pair.querySelector('.result-review-slot');
 slot.innerHTML=`<div class="score-review" role="group" aria-label="Review result"><span>CONFIRM RESULT <strong>${esc(matchSideName('A',m))} ${sc.a}–${sc.b} ${esc(matchSideName('B',m))}</strong></span><div><button type="button" data-action="cancel-result">Edit</button><button type="button" class="primary" data-action="commit-stage1" data-id="${id}">CONFIRM ✓</button></div></div>`;
 pair.querySelector('[data-action="complete-stage1"]')?.setAttribute('hidden','');
 break;
}
case 'cancel-result':pendingResult=null;document.querySelectorAll('.result-review-slot').forEach(x=>x.innerHTML='');app.querySelector('#p5-stage1-score-dialog [data-action="complete-stage1"]')?.removeAttribute('hidden');break;
case 'open-stage1-score':openStage1Score(id);break;
case 'close-stage1-score':pendingResult=null;app.querySelector('#p5-stage1-score-dialog')?.remove();break;
case 'commit-stage1':{
 if(!pendingResult||pendingResult.id!==id)throw Error('Review your result first');
 const p=pendingResult;const fields=app.querySelectorAll(`[data-stage1-score][data-id="${id}"]`);
 if([...fields].some(el=>Number(el.value)!==(el.dataset.side==='A'?p.a:p.b)))throw Error('Score changed. Review it again before confirming.');
 pendingResult=null;
 const m=E.matchPool(state).find(x=>x.id===id);if(!m||m.status!=='active')throw Error('Match is no longer active');
 const court=m.court,result=E.assignCourtResult(state,id,p.a,p.b);if(E.stage1Stats(state).team.A.played===1)arrivalDrawerOpen=false;save();render();
 const replacement=result.assigned.find(x=>x.court===court);
 notify(replacement?`C${court} · Next: ${matchSideName('A',replacement)} vs ${matchSideName('B',replacement)}`:`C${court} finished · waiting for eligible ${individualActive()?'players':'pairs'}`);
 break;
}
case 'toggle-arrival-panel':arrivalDrawerOpen=!arrivalDrawerOpen;{const body=app.querySelector('.arrival-panel-body');if(body)body.hidden=!arrivalDrawerOpen;btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(arrivalDrawerOpen));}break;
case 'toggle-arrival':{const checkedIn=E.toggleArrival(state,btn.dataset.club,Number(value));pendingResult=null;save();render();notify(checkedIn?'Pair checked in · available courts refreshed':'Marked Not Arrived · opening matches updated');break;}
case 'reshuffle-opening':{const active=E.reshuffleOpening(state,true);pendingResult=null;inspectedRound=null;save();render();notify(`Opening reshuffled · ${active.length}/${state.setup.courts} courts assigned`);break;}
case 'toggle-rounds':roundDrawerOpen=!roundDrawerOpen;const panel=app.querySelector('.rounds-drawer');if(panel){panel.hidden=!roundDrawerOpen;panel.classList.toggle('is-open',roundDrawerOpen);btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(roundDrawerOpen));}break;
case 'edit-stage1-result':{
 if(state.stage2)throw Error('Cancel Stage 2 before editing Stage 1 scores');
 const m=E.matchPool(state).find(x=>x.id===id);if(!m||m.status!=='completed')throw Error('Match history item not found');
 const container=btn.closest('.round-fixture')?.querySelector('.history-result-area');if(!container)throw Error('Open Match History first');
 // Hide any other opened editor. The match and its court assignment are not modified until Save.
 app.querySelectorAll('.history-inline-editor').forEach(x=>{const match=x.closest('.round-fixture');if(match){const key=match.dataset.matchId;const old=E.matchPool(state).find(z=>z.id===key);const area=match.querySelector('.history-result-area');if(old&&area)area.innerHTML=`<strong>${old.scoreA}–${old.scoreB}</strong><button type="button" data-action="edit-stage1-result" data-id="${old.id}">Edit Score</button>`;}});
 container.innerHTML=`<div class="history-inline-editor" role="group" aria-label="Edit match score"><label>${esc(club('A'))}<input type="number" min="0" max="${E.fmt(state.setup.format).target}" inputmode="numeric" data-history-score data-id="${id}" data-side="A" value="${m.scoreA}"></label><span aria-hidden="true">–</span><label>${esc(club('B'))}<input type="number" min="0" max="${E.fmt(state.setup.format).target}" inputmode="numeric" data-history-score data-id="${id}" data-side="B" value="${m.scoreB}"></label><div class="history-edit-actions"><button type="button" class="primary" data-action="save-stage1-amend" data-id="${id}">Save</button><button type="button" data-action="cancel-stage1-amend" data-id="${id}">Cancel</button></div></div>`;
 container.querySelector('[data-history-score][data-side="A"]')?.focus({preventScroll:true});
 break;
}
case 'save-stage1-amend':{
 if(state.stage2)throw Error('Cancel Stage 2 before editing Stage 1 scores');
 const container=btn.closest('.round-fixture');const a=container?.querySelector('[data-history-score][data-side="A"]'),b=container?.querySelector('[data-history-score][data-side="B"]');
 if(!a||!b||a.value===''||b.value==='')throw Error('Enter both scores');
 E.amendCourtResult(state,id,Number(a.value),Number(b.value));save();render();notify('Score updated · current courts unchanged');break;
}
case 'cancel-stage1-amend':{
 const container=btn.closest('.round-fixture'),area=container?.querySelector('.history-result-area'),m=E.matchPool(state).find(x=>x.id===id);
 if(area&&m)area.innerHTML=`<strong>${m.scoreA}–${m.scoreB}</strong><button type="button" data-action="edit-stage1-result" data-id="${id}">Edit Score</button>`;
 break;
}
case 'jump-leaderboard':document.querySelector('[data-unified-leaderboard]')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});break;

case 'pair-sitout':{
 if(window.P5CloudSession?.getStatus?.().role==='viewer')throw Error('View Only cannot edit pair availability');
 const side=btn.dataset.club,index=Number(value);
 if(!['A','B'].includes(side)||!Number.isInteger(index)||index<0||index>=state.setup.pairs)throw Error('Unknown pair');
 if(state.stage!=='stage1'||state.stage2)throw Error('Sit Out is available only during Stage 1');
 const next=!E.pairIsSitOut(state,side,index),name=pairName(side,index);
 const message=next?'Set Sit Out · '+name+'? An active court match will finish; pending unique fixtures are retained.':'Return to Play · '+name+'? Unplayed fixtures rejoin automatic catch-up scheduling.';
 confirmAction(message,()=>{E.setPairSitOut(state,side,index,next);pendingResult=null;},true);
 break;
}
case 'filter-leaderboard':if(['ALL','A','B'].includes(value)){leaderboardFilter=value;applyLeaderboardFilter();}break; case 'filter-division':if(['men','women','mixed'].includes(value)){setDivisionLeaderboardFilter(value);}break;
case 'view-round':roundDrawerOpen=true;inspectedRound=Number(value);render();document.querySelector('.rounds-drawer')?.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});break;
case 'latest-round':inspectedRound=null;roundDrawerOpen=true;render();break;
case 'set-courts':state.setup.courts=Number(value);state.setup.courtsManuallySelected=true;save();render();break;
case 'apply-courts':{
 const n=Number(document.querySelector('[data-setting="court-count"]')?.value);
 if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<1||n>5)throw Error('Choose 1 to 5 courts');
 const highest=Math.max(0,...E.liveCourts(state).map(m=>m.court));
 if(n<highest)throw Error(`Court ${highest} has an active match. Finish the active matches on courts above ${n} before reducing courts.`);
 if(n===state.setup.courts){notify('Court count unchanged');break;}
 state.setup.courts=n;
 if(state.stage==='stage1')E.fillAvailableCourts(state);
 save();render();goTop();notify(`${n} courts available · active matches preserved`);break;
}

case 'continue-session':{
 if(!validateAndContinueSetup())break;
 if(individualActive()){
  if(!state.setup.pairsManuallySelected||!E.individualSegments(state).length||state.setup.pairs!==E.individualPlayersPerTeam(state)||!E.individualSegments(state).every(d=>d.count>=4&&d.count<=20))throw Error('Select 4–20 players per team in each active Individual division');
 }else if(multiEnabled()){
   const counts=multiCounts();const n=['men','women','mixed'].reduce((t,k)=>t+Number(counts[k]||0),0);
   if(!multiSelectionsComplete()||n<1||n>30)throw Error('Select Men’s, Women’s, and Mixed pairs (choose 0 for unused divisions).');
   if(n!==state.setup.pairs)applyMultiCount();
 }else if(state.setup.pairsManuallySelected!==true||state.setup.pairs<1||state.setup.pairs>10){
   throw Error('Select Pairs per Team before continuing');
 }
 setupStep='registration';registrationSide='A';save();render();window.scrollTo?.(0,0);notify('Setup saved · enter player names');break;
}
case 'clear-setup':if(state.stage!=='setup')throw Error('Clear Setup is only available before a tournament starts');state=freshState();setupStep='session';registrationSide='A';editRoster=false;rosterBeforeEdit=null;save();render();notify('Setup cleared');break;
case 'back-session':setupStep='session';render();window.scrollTo?.(0,0);break;
case 'continue-format':if(state.setup.pairsManuallySelected!==true)throw Error('Select Pairs per Team');setupStep='registration';registrationSide='A';render();window.scrollTo?.(0,0);break;
case 'back-format':setupStep='session';render();window.scrollTo?.(0,0);break;
case 'competition-format':{
 const next=['classic','multi','individual'].includes(value)?value:'classic';
 const exitingIndividual=individualActive()&&next!=='individual';
 if(exitingIndividual){const n=state.setup.classicPairCountChosen&&Number.isInteger(state.setup.classicPairCount)?state.setup.classicPairCount:8;for(const c of ['A','B'])state.roster[c]=E.roster(n,c);state.setup.pairs=n;}
 if(next!==state.setup.competitionFormat){
  if(next==='individual'){
   state.setup.competitionFormat='individual';state.setup.individualDivision=state.setup.individualDivision||'single';state.setup.individualCounts=state.setup.individualCounts||{single:null,men:null,women:null};state.setup.pairsManuallySelected=false;if(state.setup.individualDivision==='multi'?(['men','women'].every(k=>Number.isInteger(state.setup.individualCounts[k])&&state.setup.individualCounts[k]>=4&&state.setup.individualCounts[k]<=20)):(Number.isInteger(state.setup.individualCounts.single)&&state.setup.individualCounts.single>=4&&state.setup.individualCounts.single<=20))applyIndividualCount();
  }else if(next==='multi'){
   if(state.setup.pairsManuallySelected===true){state.setup.classicPairCount=state.setup.pairs;state.setup.classicPairCountChosen=true;}
   state.setup.competitionFormat='multi';state.setup.pairsManuallySelected=false;
   if(multiSelectionsComplete()&&['men','women','mixed'].reduce((t,k)=>t+Number(multiCounts()[k]),0)>0)applyMultiCount();
  }else{
   state.setup.competitionFormat='classic';
   if(state.setup.classicPairCountChosen&&Number.isInteger(state.setup.classicPairCount))resizeRoster(state.setup.classicPairCount);
   else state.setup.pairsManuallySelected=false;
  }
 }
 save();render();break;}
case 'individual-division':if(individualActive()&&['single','multi'].includes(value)){state.setup.individualDivision=value;state.setup.pairsManuallySelected=false;applyIndividualCount();}break;
case 'registration-team':registrationSide=value==='B'?'B':'A';render();window.scrollTo?.(0,0);break;
case 'start':E.createMatches(state);state.roundBatchSize=state.setup.courts;inspectedRound=null;arrivalDrawerOpen=!individualActive();save();render();notify(individualActive()?(E.individualBalancedWaveMode(state)?'Individual Americano · continuous balanced courts activated':'Individual Americano · fair continuous schedule created'):'Team Round Robin created');break;
case 'wave':state.activeWave=Number(value);save();render();break;
case 'prev-wave':state.activeWave=Math.max(0,state.activeWave-1);save();render();break;
case 'next-wave':state.activeWave=Math.min(state.schedule.length-1,state.activeWave+1);save();render();break;
case 'clear-stage1-score':throw Error('Use Match History → Edit to correct a recorded result without moving active courts');
case 'jump-stage':{
 const target=value==='stage1'?'stage1':value==='stage2'?(state.stage2?'stage2':'stage2choice'):'stage3';
 if(target==='stage2choice'&&!E.stage1Stats(state).complete)throw Error('Finish Stage 1 first');
 if(target==='stage2'&&!state.stage2)throw Error('Start Stage 2 first');
 if(target==='stage3'&&!state.stage3){if(E.verdict(state).status==='final-needed'){state.stage='stage3choice';save();render();goTop();break;}else throw Error('The Decider is locked until the series is tied');}
 state.stage=target;save();render();goTop();break;
}
case 'open-share-card':if(value!=='full'||!['champion','stage1-champion'].includes(E.verdict(state).status))throw Error('Only final championship results can be shared');openShowdownShareCard('full').catch(e=>notify(e.message||String(e),true));break;
case 'share-stage-text':if(value!=='full'||!['champion','stage1-champion'].includes(E.verdict(state).status))throw Error('Only final championship results can be shared');shareStageText('full').catch(e=>notify(e.message||String(e),true));break;
case 'view-final-verdict':{
 const v=E.verdict(state);
 if(v.status!=='champion'||!v.champion)throw Error('Finish the championship before viewing the final verdict');
 state.finalized=true;state.stage='finished';save();render();goTop();break;
}
case 'replay-champion':showChampionReveal();break;
case 'open-duel-score':openDuelScore(value,id);break;
case 'close-duel-score':pendingDuelReview=null;app.querySelector('#p5-duel-score-dialog')?.remove();break;
case 'review-duel-score':reviewDuel('duel',id);break;
case 'review-final-score':reviewDuel('final',id);break;
case 'cancel-duel-review':pendingDuelReview=null;app.querySelectorAll('.duel-review-slot').forEach(el=>el.innerHTML='');app.querySelector('#p5-duel-score-dialog [data-action^="review-"]')?.removeAttribute('hidden');break;
case 'confirm-duel-score':confirmDuelScore(value,id);break;
case 'review-early-finish':openEarlyFinishAdvisor(value==='duel'?'duel':'final');break;
case 'close-early-finish':app.querySelector('#p5-early-finish-dialog')?.remove();break;
case 'early-finish-now':app.querySelector('#p5-early-finish-dialog')?.remove();act({dataset:{action:value==='duel'?'choose-stage2':'finish-stage1',id:'',value:''}});break;
case 'start-smart-fair-finish':{
 const plan=E.individualSmartFinishPlan(state,5);
 confirmAction(`Smart Fair Finish will preserve ${E.liveCourts(state).length} LIVE match(es) and schedule up to ${plan.count} additional real match(es) chosen automatically for both teams. Estimated maximum player gap: ${plan.baselineGap} → ${plan.projectedGap}. The engine may reduce extras when fairness improves. Confirm?`,()=>{
  E.individualStartSmartFinish(state);app.querySelector('#p5-early-finish-dialog')?.remove();
 });break;
}
case 'early-finish-live':{
 confirmAction(`Finish Stage 1 AFTER all ${E.liveCourts(state).length} currently LIVE match(es) are scored? No extra matches will be dispatched, and recorded scores will not be altered.`,()=>{
  E.individualFinishAfterLive(state);app.querySelector('#p5-early-finish-dialog')?.remove();
 });break;
}
case 'cancel-equalization':confirmAction('Cancel Equalization and resume the normal schedule? All confirmed scores and LIVE matches remain valid.',()=>E.individualCancelEqualization(state));break;
case 'choose-stage2':if(state.stage2){state.stage='stage2';save();render();goTop();break;}if(!E.stage1Stats(state).complete){if(!E.stage1Stats(state).team.A.played)throw Error('Record at least one Stage 1 result first');confirmAction('Finish Stage 1 early and continue to Team Duel? '+stage1FinishWarning(),()=>{state.stage1Closed=true;state.equalization=null;for(const m of E.liveCourts(state)){m.status='pending';m.court=null;m.sequence=null;}state.nextMatchQueue=[];state.lockedNextMatchId=null;state.stage='stage2choice';});break;}state.stage='stage2choice';save();render();break;
case 'create-duels':{const count=Number(document.getElementById('duelCount').value),format=document.getElementById('duelFormat').value;if(!E.allowedDuels(state.setup.pairs,2).includes(count)||!E.formats.includes(format)){const el=document.getElementById('duelSetupError');if(el){el.hidden=false;el.textContent='Choose the number of duels and Stage 2 match format before continuing.';}throw Error('Select number of duels and Stage 2 format first');}E.makeStage2(state,count,format);save();render();goTop();break;}
case 'save-all-lineups':saveAllLineups(value);break;
case 'save-duel-lineup':E.setDuelLineup(state,id,getLineup('duel',id,'A'),getLineup('duel',id,'B'));save();render();notify('Lineup saved');break;
case 'clear-duel-lineup':confirmAction(`Clear the lineup for Duel ${id.split('-').pop()}? Its saved score will also be removed.`,()=>E.clearDuelLineup(state,id));break;
case 'save-duel-score':{const q=readTwoScores('duel',id);E.setDuelScore(state,id,q.a,q.b,q.winner);save();render();notify('Duel result saved');break;}
case 'save-final-lineup':E.setFinalLineup(state,getLineup('final',id,'A'),getLineup('final',id,'B'),id);save();render();notify('Final lineup saved');break;
case 'save-final-score':{const q=readTwoScores('final',id);E.setFinalScore(state,q.a,q.b,q.winner,id);save();render();notify('Decider result saved');break;}
case 'begin-final':state.stage='stage3choice';save();render();goTop();break;
case 'create-final':{const count=Number(document.getElementById('finalCount')?.value),format=document.getElementById('finalFormat')?.value;if(!E.allowedDuels(state.setup.pairs,3).includes(count)||!E.formats.includes(format)){const el=document.getElementById('finalSetupError');if(el){el.hidden=false;el.textContent='Choose number of duels and match format before continuing.';}throw Error('Select Stage 3 duels and format first');}E.startFinal(state,format,count);save();render();goTop();break;}
case 'clear-final-lineup':confirmAction('Clear this Stage 3 lineup and its score?',()=>E.clearFinalLineup(state,id));break; case 'add-final-tiebreak':E.addFinalTieBreaker(state);save();render();goTop();notify('Final tie-break duel created');break;
case 'resume-stage1':if(state.stage2)throw Error('Cancel Stage 2 before reopening Stage 1');if(!state.stage1Closed)throw Error('Stage 1 already open');confirmAction('Reopen Stage 1 scoring? Confirmed scores will be preserved. Only remaining legal fixtures will be assigned to courts.',()=>{state.stage1Closed=false;state.finalized=false;state.equalization=null;state.lockedNextMatchId=null;E.fillAvailableCourts(state);});break;
case 'finish-stage1':{
 if(state.stage2)throw Error('Cancel Stage 2 before finishing the tournament after Stage 1');
 const st=E.stage1Stats(state);
 if(!st.team.A.played)throw Error('Confirm at least one Stage 1 match score before finishing.');
 // Stage 1 allows a stage-only championship. Wins, then Games Won, decide it.
 // For an exact tie, do NOT fabricate a champion; recommend Team Duel instead.
 const winner=st.team.A.w>st.team.B.w?'A':st.team.B.w>st.team.A.w?'B':st.team.A.p>st.team.B.p?'A':st.team.B.p>st.team.A.p?'B':null;
 if(!winner)throw Error('Stage 1 is tied on match wins and total games. Continue to Team Duel or play more matches to determine a champion.');
 const finalize=()=>{
  state.stage1Closed=true;state.equalization=null;
  for(const m of E.liveCourts(state)){m.status='pending';m.court=null;m.sequence=null;}
  state.nextMatchQueue=[];state.lockedNextMatchId=null;
  state.stage='finished';state.finalized=true;
  if(E.verdict(state).status!=='stage1-champion'||E.verdict(state).champion!==winner)throw Error('Stage 1 winner consistency check failed; tournament was not finalized');
  // Confirmation handler saves and renders; show a non-blocking champion result after rendering.
  setTimeout(()=>showChampionReveal(),80);
 };
 if(!st.complete){
  confirmAction('Finish tournament after Stage 1 and declare '+club(winner)+' the winner? '+stage1FinishWarning()+' Stage 2 and Stage 3 will be skipped.',finalize);
 }else{
  confirmAction('Finish tournament after Stage 1 and declare '+club(winner)+' the winner? This will skip Stage 2 and Stage 3.',finalize);
 }
 break;
}
case 'finish-all':if(!['champion','stage1-champion'].includes(E.verdict(state).status))throw Error('Complete the deciding matches first');state.stage='finished';state.finalized=true;save();render();showChampionReveal();break;
case 'back-stage1':state.stage='stage1';save();render();goTop();break;
case 'reopen-stage1':state.stage='stage1';if(!state.stage2)state.finalized=false;save();render();goTop();notify('Viewing Stage 1 results');break;
case 'reopen-stage2':if(!state.stage2)throw Error('Stage 2 has not started');state.stage='stage2';state.finalized=false;save();render();goTop();notify('Returned to Stage 2');break;
case 'open-stage3-setup':if(state.stage3||E.verdict(state).status!=='final-needed')throw Error('The Decider setup is available only when Stage 1 and Stage 2 are tied 1–1');state.stage='stage3choice';save();render();goTop();break;
case 'reopen-stage3':if(!state.stage3)throw Error('The Decider has not started');state.stage='stage3';state.finalized=false;save();render();goTop();notify('Returned to The Decider');break;
case 'edit-roster':if(!editRoster)rosterBeforeEdit=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({roster:state.roster,clubs:state.setup.clubs,colors:state.setup.teamColors}));editRoster=true;render();goTop();notify('Edit names, then select Save Roster Changes');break;
case 'save-roster':safeRoster();editRoster=false;rosterBeforeEdit=null;save();render();goTop();notify('Team and player names saved');break;
case 'cancel-roster':if(rosterBeforeEdit){state.roster=rosterBeforeEdit.roster;state.setup.clubs=rosterBeforeEdit.clubs;state.setup.teamColors=rosterBeforeEdit.colors;}rosterBeforeEdit=null;editRoster=false;render();goTop();notify('Roster edits discarded');break;
case 'reset-stage1':confirmAction('Reset ALL Stage 1 scores and restart court assignments? This also cancels Stage 2 and Stage 3.',()=>{E.createMatches(state);arrivalDrawerOpen=true;state.roundBatchSize=state.setup.courts;roundDrawerOpen=false;inspectedRound=null;pendingResult=null;});break;
case 'reset-stage2':confirmAction('Reset all Stage 2 scores and cancel the deciding match?',()=>{if(!state.stage2)throw Error('Stage 2 has not started');state.stage2.matches.forEach(m=>Object.assign(m,{scoreA:null,scoreB:null,winner:null}));state.stage3=null;state.stage='stage2';state.finalized=false;});break;
case 'reset-stage3':confirmAction('Reset all Stage 3 scores? Saved lineups remain.',()=>{if(!state.stage3)throw Error('Stage 3 has not started');E.stage3Matches(state).forEach(m=>Object.assign(m,{scoreA:null,scoreB:null,winner:null}));state.stage='stage3';state.finalized=false;pendingDuelReview=null;});break;
case 'cancel-stage3':confirmAction('Cancel Stage 3 and return to setup? Stage 1 and Stage 2 results remain intact.',()=>{if(!state.stage3)throw Error('Stage 3 has not started');state.stage3=null;state.stage='stage3choice';state.finalized=false;pendingDuelReview=null;});break;
case 'cancel-stage2':confirmAction('Cancel Stage 2 and return to the Stage 1 results?',()=>{state.stage2=null;state.stage3=null;state.stage='stage1';state.finalized=false;});break;
case 'new':confirmAction('Start a brand-new Team Showdown? Back up your current session first.',()=>{state=freshState();setupStep='session';registrationSide='A';editRoster=false;rosterBeforeEdit=null;roundDrawerOpen=false;arrivalDrawerOpen=true;inspectedRound=null;pendingResult=null;leaderboardFilter='ALL';divisionLeaderboardFilter='men';shareId=null;localStorage.removeItem('padel5ive-showdown-share-id');});break;
case 'backup':downloadFile(JSON.stringify(state,null,2),`PADEL5IVE_SHOWDOWN_BACKUP_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.json`);break;
case 'restore':document.getElementById('restoreInput').click();break;
case 'pdf':{
 if(state.setup.competitionFormat==='multi'||state.setup.competitionFormat==='individual'||typeof window.P5DirectPDF==='undefined'){
   printReport();notify('Division-separated report opened · Print / Save as PDF');break;
 }
 P5DirectPDF.exportShowdown(showdownReportData()).then(o=>{if(o.cancelled)return;notify(o.shared?'PDF sent to iOS share sheet':'Official PDF saved · Open Downloads / Save to Files');}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);notify('PDF export failed: '+e.message,true);});break;
}
case 'share':shareResults().catch(e=>notify(e.message||String(e),true));break;
default:break;
}}catch(e){console.error(e);notify(e.message||String(e),true);}}
// v0.8.6: direct menu button dispatch + touch fallback (Safari/iPadOS).
// Static buttons are bound directly, rather than only through a document-level delegate.
const menuButtons=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll?.('#mainMenu button[data-action]')||[]);
const menuLastTap=new WeakMap();
for(const btn of menuButtons){
 let touchStart=null;
 btn.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{
   const t=e.changedTouches?.[0];if(t)touchStart={x:t.clientX,y:t.clientY};
 },{passive:true});
 btn.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{
   if(!touchStart||btn.disabled)return;
   const t=e.changedTouches?.[0];if(!t)return;
   const dist=Math.hypot(t.clientX-touchStart.x,t.clientY-touchStart.y);
   touchStart=null;
   if(dist>12)return; // allow scrolling through the menu normally
   e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
   menuLastTap.set(btn,Date.now());
   act(btn);
 },{passive:false});
 btn.addEventListener('touchcancel',()=>{touchStart=null;},{passive:true});
 btn.addEventListener('click',e=>{
   e.stopPropagation();
   if(btn.disabled||Date.now()-(menuLastTap.get(btn)||0)<650)return;
   act(btn);
 });
}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
 const trigger=e.target.closest?.('[data-confirm]');
 if(trigger){e.preventDefault();resolveConfirmation(trigger.dataset.confirm==='yes');return;}
 if(e.target.id==='confirmLayer'){resolveConfirmation(false);return;}
 if(e.target.id==='p5-early-finish-dialog'){e.target.remove();return;}
 const btn=e.target.closest?.('button[data-action]');
 if(btn&&!btn.closest('#mainMenu'))act(btn);
});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key!=='Escape')return;if(document.getElementById('p5-stage1-score-dialog')){pendingResult=null;document.getElementById('p5-stage1-score-dialog').remove();return;}if(document.getElementById('p5-duel-score-dialog')){pendingDuelReview=null;document.getElementById('p5-duel-score-dialog').remove();return;}if(document.getElementById('showdownShareLayer')){sdCloseShareCard();return;}if(document.getElementById('showdownRevealLayer')){document.getElementById('showdownRevealLayer').remove();return;}if(document.getElementById('p5-early-finish-dialog')){document.getElementById('p5-early-finish-dialog').remove();return;}if(!document.getElementById('confirmLayer').hidden)resolveConfirmation(false);});
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{const el=e.target;if(el.matches('[data-field]:not([data-field="pairs"])')){setField(el);const wrap=el.closest('.setup-invalid');if(wrap){wrap.classList.remove('setup-invalid');wrap.querySelector('.setup-field-error')?.remove();el.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');}}if(el.matches('[data-stage1-score]'))setAutoScore(el);if(el.matches('[data-history-score]'))setHistoryAutoScore(el);if(el.matches('[data-custom-score]'))setDuelAutoScore(el);});
document.addEventListener('focusin',e=>{const el=e.target;if(el.matches?.('select[data-lineup]')&&!lineupPriorValue.has(el))lineupPriorValue.set(el,el.value);}); // Native iOS select/date controls may dispatch a change without a separate input event.
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{const el=e.target;if(el.matches('[data-lineup]'))onLineupSelectionChanged(el);if(el.matches('[data-field="format"],[data-field="date"],[data-field="pairs"],[data-field="division-count"]')){setField(el);const wrap=el.closest('.setup-invalid');if(wrap){wrap.classList.remove('setup-invalid');wrap.querySelector('.setup-field-error')?.remove();el.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');}}});
// Scores are committed ONLY by Finish Match, never on field blur; prevents double-dispatch.

document.getElementById('restoreInput').addEventListener('change',async e=>{const file=e.target.files[0];if(!file)return;try{const obj=JSON.parse(await file.text());if(!E.validateSavedState(obj))throw Error('Invalid or unsupported Team Showdown backup');confirmAction('Restore this backup and replace the current Team Showdown? The current session will be overwritten.',()=>{state=E.migrateLegacySchedule(obj);E.ensureSitOut(state);if(state.stage==='stage1')E.fillAvailableCourts(state);viewOnly=false;editRoster=false;rosterBeforeEdit=null;shareId=state.publicShareId||null;localStorage.removeItem('padel5ive-showdown-share-id');setupStep='session';registrationSide='A';roundDrawerOpen=false;inspectedRound=null;pendingResult=null;pendingDuelReview=null;});}catch(err){notify(err.message||'Invalid backup',true);}e.target.value='';});
// v0.9.4: Share Results belongs to the CURRENT saved tournament, never a global last-used URL.
shareId=state.publicShareId||null;
// Never briefly reveal local moderator session on a public results URL.
if(/^\/(?:r|i)\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{6,32}\/?$/.test(location.pathname)){viewOnly=true;document.body.classList.add('sd-public-only');app.innerHTML='<section class="card"><h2>PADEL 5IVE · OFFICIAL RESULTS</h2><p>Loading published results…</p></section>';loadPublic();}
else render();
})();

@media screen and (max-width:420px){.p5-division-filter .p5-division-tab{font-size:10px;padding:8px 3px}}

/* v0.6 · Direct visual port of the First Edition Americano/Mexicano court card.
 * Source component classes: .p5sm-open-score / .scorepair / .p5sm-scorebox.
 * Team Showdown engine and confirmed-result ledger are unchanged. */
.match-center .court-grid{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:10px!important}
.match-center .court.p5sm-card{display:block;position:relative;width:100%;min-width:0;padding:16px 17px 13px!important;border:1px solid rgba(196,168,132,.58)!important;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(38,54,65,.95),rgba(26,40,51,.95))!important}
.match-center .p5sm-card .court-header{border-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0;margin-bottom:5px}
.match-center .p5sm-card .court-header strong{font-size:11px;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#ddb98b}
.match-center .p5sm-card .court-status{color:#e2c39a;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.07em}
.p5sm-open-score{display:block!important;width:100%;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;color:inherit;padding:0!important;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:none!important;border-radius:0!important}
.p5sm-open-score:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.65}
.p5sm-open-score .scorepairs{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 17px minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:9px!important;align-items:center;margin:9px 0 8px!important}
.p5sm-open-score .scorepair{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;justify-content:flex-start;gap:12px;min-width:0;text-align:center}
.p5sm-open-score .pairname{min-height:36px;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:1.4;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:680;color:#f1f1f0;text-align:center;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.p5sm-open-score .p5sm-scorebox{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:55px;width:100%;font-size:30px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:760;color:#f5eee3;background:rgba(7,17,27,.56);border:1px solid rgba(167,176,183,.39);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.p5sm-open-score .p5sm-score-separator{font-size:22px;line-height:1;align-self:end;padding-bottom:19px;color:#bba990;text-align:center}
.match-center .p5sm-card>.scorehint{display:block;margin:7px 0 2px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#aebbc6;letter-spacing:.02em}
.p5sm-duel-card .p5sm-open-score{margin:10px 0 3px}
.p5sm-duel-card .p5sm-open-score .pairname{min-height:45px}
.p5sm-duel-card>.scorehint{text-align:center;margin:7px 0 11px;font-size:11px;color:#aebbc6}
.p5sm-duel-card .duel-lineup-details{margin-top:13px}
.duel-cards-grid{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:12px!important}
/* Reused Match Control modal anatomy: score labels, two input wells, and confirm/cancel. */
.p5-v2-overlay.p5-showdown-score-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:110500;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;background:rgba(1,5,11,.81);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.p5-showdown-score-modal{width:min(520px,100%);max-height:calc(100dvh - 32px);overflow:auto;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#263742,#151d27);border:1px solid #aa8c62;border-radius:18px;padding:23px;box-shadow:0 12px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:#f2e8d8}
.p5-showdown-score-modal h2{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.045em;color:#f5e8d4;margin:6px 0 15px;font-weight:760}
.p5sm-modal-over{color:#d5b486;letter-spacing:.13em;font-size:10px;font-weight:760}
.p5-showdown-score-modal .p5-v2-modal-score,.p5-showdown-score-modal .duel-score-grid{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 18px minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:14px 0}
.p5-showdown-score-modal .p5-v2-modal-score>label,.p5-showdown-score-modal .duel-score-grid>label{min-width:0;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:12px;margin:0;color:#f2eee5;line-height:1.4;font-size:12px;font-weight:670}
.p5-showdown-score-modal .p5-v2-modal-score>label span,.p5-showdown-score-modal .duel-score-grid>label span{min-height:35px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.p5-showdown-score-modal .p5-v2-modal-score input,.p5-showdown-score-modal .duel-score-grid input{display:block;width:100%;max-width:none;text-align:center;min-height:65px;font-size:32px;font-weight:750;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#f7e7cf!important;border:1px solid #97816b!important;border-radius:10px!important;background:#121d27!important;padding:8px!important;appearance:textfield;-moz-appearance:textfield}
.p5-showdown-score-modal input::-webkit-inner-spin-button,.p5-showdown-score-modal input::-webkit-outer-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0}
.p5sm-modal-versus,.p5-showdown-score-modal .duel-score-grid>strong{font-size:21px;color:#c7b297;text-align:center;font-weight:400;margin-top:36px}
.p5sm-modal-hint{font-size:11px;text-align:center;line-height:1.5;color:#aebac4;margin:5px 0 14px}
.p5sm-modal-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:9px;margin-top:15px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.p5sm-modal-actions button{padding:12px 17px;min-height:43px}
.p5sm-modal-actions button[hidden]{display:none!important}
.p5sm-modal-pairs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:15px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;line-height:1.5;color:#f3efe5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.p5-showdown-score-modal .score-review{margin:15px 0 8px}
.p5-showdown-score-modal .duel-score-section,.p5-showdown-score-modal .duel-review-slot{display:block}
/* Mobile navigation mirrors Match Control active/inactive color, geometry and icons. */
@media screen and (max-width:700px){
 .match-center .court-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
 .match-center .court.p5sm-card{padding:14px 14px 12px!important}
 .p5sm-open-score .pairname{font-size:12px!important;min-height:41px}
 .p5sm-open-score .p5sm-scorebox{min-height:52px;font-size:29px}
 .p5-v2-overlay.p5-showdown-score-overlay{padding:12px}
 .p5-showdown-score-modal{padding:19px 15px}
 body.p5-native-tabbed .p5-native-bottom-nav:not([hidden]){display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:9px;background:#1d2933;border-top:1px solid rgba(194,166,126,.26);padding:9px 12px calc(9px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
 .p5-native-bottom-nav button{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:49px;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:670!important;letter-spacing:0;color:#aeb6be;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:10px;background:transparent}
 .p5-native-bottom-nav button[aria-selected="true"]{background:#323238;border:1px solid #a58a67;color:#f2e6d4}
 .p5-native-bottom-nav .p5-nav-icon{stroke:#b2a17f;width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}
 .p5-native-bottom-nav button[aria-selected="true"] .p5-nav-icon{stroke:#d4b58d}
}
@media screen and (min-width:701px){.p5-native-bottom-nav{display:none!important}}
@media print{.p5-showdown-score-overlay{display:none!important}}

/* v0.7 · Session compact polish + division identity. No game-engine changes. */
.p5-si-compact{padding:13px 17px!important;margin-bottom:12px!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(35,47,57,.95),rgba(25,37,47,.94))!important}
.p5-si-compact-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;min-width:0}
.p5-si-compact-title{min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:11px}
.p5-si-compact-over{font-size:9px;font-weight:780;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#c6a37b;flex:none}
.p5-si-compact-title strong{font-size:17px;font-weight:730;line-height:1.35;color:#f4ece2;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.p5-si-compact .p5-si-status{padding:6px 11px!important;font-size:10px!important}
.p5-si-compact-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(176,185,192,.23);margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px 15px}
.p5-si-compact-format{font-size:10px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#cfae85;line-height:1.45}
.p5-si-compact-format i{font-style:normal;color:#8b939a;margin:0 2px}
.p5-si-compact-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#b9c4cc;font-size:11px;font-weight:550}
.p5-si-compact-meta span{white-space:nowrap}
.match-center .p5sm-card .p5-court-heading{min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.match-center .p5sm-card .p5-court-heading>strong{font-size:11px;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#ddb98b}
.p5-court-division{display:inline-block;font-size:9px!important;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.075em;font-weight:760;color:#d5d9dc;padding:5px 7px;border:1px solid rgba(176,196,209,.33);border-radius:5px;background:rgba(30,47,59,.75);white-space:nowrap}
.p5-court-division-men{border-color:rgba(104,166,203,.44);color:#b9dcef;background:rgba(34,67,87,.42)}
.p5-court-division
